messages.content: The coordinator changed Thursday transportation. The team vehicle will take us to the site in the morning, but it will not return to the hotel until after an equipment drop. I cannot leave my checked bag at the site, and I cannot wait for that vehicle. Can the hotel hand my stored bag to a scheduled driver?

I’ll verify the hotel’s release procedure and then price a car from the audit site to the hotel and onward to IND. What time can you leave the site on Thursday, and is the flight still the 6:35 p.m. nonstop?
Yes, 6:35 p.m. I should be able to leave at 3:00, but allow five minutes in case the closing discussion runs over. I will be checking the bag.

The hotel can release stored luggage to a scheduled driver, but it requires your written authorization before checkout. The note must name the driver or car service, describe the bag, and authorize release on Thursday. The driver must show photo identification and your luggage claim ticket. The front desk will not release it based only on a phone call.
Can I leave the claim ticket with the desk when I store the bag and send the authorization through the reservation message? I will not know the driver’s name until dispatch.

Yes. The hotel will retain the claim ticket with the bag. You can send the authorization through the reservation message now naming the car service, then update it with the driver’s full name once assigned. They asked that the final name arrive by 2:30 p.m. Thursday. The driver will still need matching photo ID.
Good. Price the direct route with the hotel stop. I do not want a separate courier handling the luggage unless that is the only workable option.

A reserved sedan from the audit site at 3:05 p.m., stopping at the business hotel and continuing to IND, is estimated at $74 including the scheduled stop and ordinary fees. Waiting beyond ten minutes at the hotel is $1.25 per minute. A separate luggage courier plus an airport ride would be about $96, so the single car is both simpler and less expensive.
How much time does the single-car plan leave at the airport? Use realistic Thursday traffic, not the best-case drive time.

With Thursday afternoon traffic, the working schedule is: leave the site at 3:05, reach the hotel around 3:30, depart with the bag by 3:40, and arrive at IND around 4:10. That gives you about two hours twenty-five minutes before departure and about one hour forty minutes before the airline’s 45-minute checked-bag cutoff at 5:50 p.m. Even a 25-minute traffic delay would put you at the terminal around 4:35.
That margin is sufficient. Is the $74 fixed, and does the driver wait while the front desk releases the bag?

The base transportation amount and hotel stop are fixed when reserved; tolls, exceptional waiting time, and a requested gratuity are not included. Ten minutes of hotel waiting is included. The dispatcher has confirmed that the same driver will remain with the vehicle while the front desk releases the bag.
Reserve it for 3:05 and send the hotel authorization. Add enough detail that the desk does not confuse this with the old note about pickup after the returning shuttle.

The sedan is reserved for Thursday at 3:05 p.m. under CAR-70941, with pickup at the audit site, one luggage stop at the business hotel, and final drop at IND. The confirmed amount is $74 before any excess waiting, tolls, or gratuity. I sent the hotel a new instruction tied to NBH-76428 stating that the earlier post-shuttle pickup plan is superseded and authorizing the scheduled car service to collect your stored checked bag. The hotel acknowledged the change and will hold the claim ticket with the bag. Driver details must be added by 2:30 p.m. Thursday.
Give me the exact Thursday sequence and identify the one item I still need to handle.

Thursday: check out by 11:00 a.m., store the checked bag at the front desk, and leave the claim ticket with it. Take the team vehicle to the audit site. Meet sedan CAR-70941 at 3:05 p.m.; expected hotel arrival is 3:30, departure with the bag by 3:40, and IND arrival around 4:10 for the 6:35 p.m. nonstop. The remaining action is to obtain the assigned driver’s full name and send it to the hotel by 2:30 p.m. Thursday. Retain the car confirmation, hotel acknowledgment, and final receipt.
